Agustin Canobbio.note: Canobbio has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Cabo Verde. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Agustin Canobbio.noteZh: 他已经为Uruguay进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Brian Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez gives Uruguay a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Brian Rodriguez.noteZh: 他是Uruguay在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Darwin Nunez.note: Núñez is in the scouting report now. For Uruguay, that means his touches can pull help away from the next runner.
Darwin Nunez.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这届赛事的一条进攻路径。看他面对球门接球时，第一名防守者怎么反应。

Emiliano Martinez.note: Martínez gives Uruguay midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uruguay来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Facundo Pellistri.note: Pellistri is attacking depth for Uruguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Facundo Pellistri.noteZh: 他是Uruguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Federico Valverde.note: Valverde has been one of Uruguay's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Federico Valverde.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Federico Vinas.note: Viñas is attacking depth for Uruguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Federico Vinas.noteZh: 他是Uruguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Fernando Muslera.note: Muslera gives Uruguay the calmest first pass from the back. Watch how quickly he turns a save or claim into a reset.
Fernando Muslera.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这段征程中的门将。价值在于让禁区保持冷静，并让下一次进攻能干净开始。

Giorgian De Arrascaeta.note: Arrascaeta gives Uruguay midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Giorgian De Arrascaeta.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uruguay来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Guillermo Varela.note: Varela has been part of Uruguay's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Guillermo Varela.noteZh: 他给Uruguay后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Joaquin Piquerez.note: Piquerez is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Joaquin Piquerez.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Jose Maria Gimenez.note: Giménez is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Jose Maria Gimenez.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Juan Manuel Sanabria.note: Sanabria gives Uruguay another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Juan Manuel Sanabria.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Manuel Ugarte.note: Ugarte gives Uruguay structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Manuel Ugarte.noteZh: 他给Uruguay控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Mathias Olivera.note: Olivera has been part of Uruguay's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Mathias Olivera.noteZh: 他给Uruguay后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Matias Vina.note: Viña gives Uruguay cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Matias Vina.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Maxi Araujo.note: Araújo has already shaped Uruguay's tournament with goals against Saudi Arabia and Cabo Verde and service for teammates. Watch how quickly his next action follows the first touch.
Maxi Araujo.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Uruguay带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Nicolas De La Cruz.note: Cruz is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Uruguay, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Nicolas De La Cruz.noteZh: 他给Uruguay提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Rodrigo Aguirre.note: Aguirre is an attacking change-up for Uruguay. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Rodrigo Aguirre.noteZh: 他是Uruguay的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Rodrigo Bentancur.note: Bentancur has been one of Uruguay's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Rodrigo Bentancur.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Rodrigo Zalazar.note: Zalazar is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Uruguay, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Rodrigo Zalazar.noteZh: 他给Uruguay提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ronald Araujo.note: Araújo is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Ronald Araujo.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Santiago Bueno.note: Bueno gives Uruguay cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Santiago Bueno.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Santiago Mele.note: Mele gives Uruguay a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Santiago Mele.noteZh: 他在Uruguay首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Sebastian Caceres.note: Cáceres gives Uruguay one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Sebastian Caceres.noteZh: 他是Uruguay无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Sergio Rochet.note: Rochet sits behind the starter for Uruguay, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Sergio Rochet.noteZh: 他给Uruguay保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。
